rec.name: Competitor Comparison Table (Us vs. Others)

what.text: A dark-themed comparison table that sets the brand against competitors (e.g. "Other providers", "Freelancers") across about 7 feature rows. Each cell shows a green check or a red cross. The brand's column is highlighted as a tall, glowing neon-green pill that runs the full height of the table. Above the table sit a headline and an optional subline. Rows alternate between a darker and a slightly lighter band for readability. The ticket's example copy is for Sectionfy: "Why leading Shopify shops choose Sectionfy".

why.text: Side-by-side comparison lets buyers evaluate the offer against alternatives right on the page, so they don't have to leave and research competitors. The highlighted brand column pulls the eye and makes the brand look like the clear winner. Rows where competitors fail (red crosses) trigger loss aversion and make the unique selling points concrete. Headlines framed around other successful brands ("Why leading shops choose...") add a social-proof angle.

how.text: Build it as a section with a configurable headline and subline, a header row of 3 columns (brand + 2 competitors, each with an optional logo/icon and title), and repeatable row blocks (feature label + check/cross per column). Style the brand column as a rounded, full-height, highlighted bar (e.g. neon green with glow) behind its cells. Use alternating row backgrounds. Check = green, cross = red. Keep copy short and factual. Comments show the headline was iterated and finalised as "Why leading Shopify shops choose Sectionfy". The design was also created as a static graphic (square format) in addition to the section layout.

items: Competitor column titles (2) and optional logos/icons
Feature rows: label + check/cross toggle per column
Highlight colour of brand column (neon green with glow)

dependencies.text: No apps or metafields apparent. Needs a theme section with repeatable row blocks and a per-cell check/cross toggle. Content (claims about competitors) must be provided and legally verified by the client. The source images are design mockups, so the actual Liquid build is not shown.

items: Conversion rate of visitors who see the section
Click-through on the CTA near the table

images.caption: Square graphic version with the headline "Why big e-com brands trust Sectionfy", a glowing green brand column and 2 placeholder competitor columns
Column header close-up with logo placeholders above the brand and competitor titles, and 7 feature rows
Inspiration/reference: a competitor's comparison graphic with a dark highlighted brand column, 8 rows and emoji check/cross icons
Final section layout with headline "We set new standards", subline, brand column and "Other providers" / "Freelancers" columns
